Definition: Total meals prepared by a kitchen for a service date
Interpretation: Volume of meals produced before dispatch

Definition: Total meals dispatched from a kitchen or to a school
Interpretation: Volume of meals sent from kitchens to schools

Definition: Total meals acknowledged as received at a school
Interpretation: Volume of dispatched meals confirmed as received by the school

Definition: Total successful valid Tap2Eat meal transactions
Interpretation: Meals represented by valid successful Tap2Eat transactions after data-quality filtering

Definition: Difference between meals prepared and meals dispatched
Interpretation: Highlights meals prepared but not represented in dispatch records

Definition: Share of prepared meals that were dispatched
Interpretation: Illustrative review flag when below 95 percent

Definition: Difference between meals dispatched and meals received
Interpretation: Highlights potential losses or reconciliation differences between dispatch and receipt

Definition: Share of dispatched meals recorded as received
Interpretation: Illustrative review flag when below 95 percent

Definition: Difference between meals received and meals served
Interpretation: Highlights received meals not represented by valid successful Tap2Eat transactions

Definition: Share of received meals represented as served
Interpretation: Illustrative review flag when below 90 percent

Definition: Meals served relative to eligible learners
Interpretation: Indicates meal uptake relative to the eligible learner population

Definition: Tap2Eat transactions excluded from operational marts because they fail defined quality rules
Interpretation: Non-blocking quality exceptions retained for investigation rather than silently discarded
